allow: PowerShell(npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | Select-String "error TS" | ForEach-Object { $_.Line }; if \($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0\) { "TSC CLEAN" })
PowerShell(npx vitest run 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern "Test Files|Tests |FAIL|❯|×" | ForEach-Object { $_.Line } | Select-Object -First 80)
PowerShell(npx vitest run 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern "Test Files|Tests |FAIL|✗|×|AssertionError|Expected|Received" | ForEach-Object { $_.Line } | Select-Object -First 60)
PowerShell(npx eslint "src/**/*.ts"; if \($?\) { "ESLINT CLEAN" } else { "ESLINT ERRORS" })

description: Pre-authorized tools for autonomous agent operation. Agents can read files, search code, delegate tasks, and perform version control without permission interruptions.
